notes.title: announcement
notes.notes:
Dear Dreamland players

Dreamland has been loved by everyone since its launch, but at the same time, we have discovered a major issue. In order not to affect everyone's gaming experience, we have temporarily closed the entrance. We are urgently repairing the relevant issues and will reopen the entrance after the repair. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and thank you for your understanding.

Dreamland Team
